{{Top}}
{{Rhere|Sharpshooter|''[[Sharpshooter (game)|Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Sharpshooter]]''}}
{{Quote|I see the shooter up in the tower!|Anonymous [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]]|<ref name="Hostage Crisis">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>}}
[[File:Rebel_marksman_BF.jpg|right|thumb|A [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|Rebel Marksman]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]]]
A '''sniper''', '''sharpshooter''', or '''marksman''', was an individual trained to shoot an opponent from a distance, often hundreds to a thousand [[Meter/Legends|meters]] away, and often from a concealed location. Patience, steady aim, and cunning were some of the attributes that were needed for a sniper. Stealth was a sniper's greatest asset.

Snipers could be [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who remove important opposition personnel and targets of opportunity in times of war, [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] who kill unwitting marks from a distance, or part of a security force trained as counter-snipers to protect important social or political figures.

Snipers were employed as combat units during numerous galactic conflicts such as the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These units included specialized [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Imperial]] [[Imperial Agent|agents]], [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone sharpshooters]], [[Battle droid assassin|assassin droids]], [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|Rebel Marksmans]], and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Imperial]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]]. Some of these snipers were equipped with [[Probe droid/Legends|recon droids]] for scouting and calling down [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. The [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel SpecForce]] also hired snipers such as [[Myn Donos]], who went on to become a member of [[Wraith Squadron]], and referred to their snipers as "TK"s, short for "[[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]]," because of their ability to invisibly "touch" their target from great distances.

==History==
===Great Galactic War and Cold War===
During the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed it circa [[3653 BBY]], the term "sniper" was used to refer to a specific breed of [[Imperial Agent]].<ref name="Imperial Agent">{{Holonet|classes|imperial-agent|Imperial Agent}}</ref> These operatives served the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and were combat capable. They were known for wielding [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] fitted with long-range [[Scope/Legends|scopes]].<ref name="FanFriday">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100820-0|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday (August 20, 2010)|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] had an entire [[Sniper combat specialization program|training program]] dedicated to the art of shooting.

The [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army branch]] of the Sith Empire also had several larger military units which specialized sniper combat. The [[Imperial sniper corps]] was responsible for training these army units. Among these was the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]-sized the [[Four Hundred and Third|403rd]] and one of it's sub-unit named [[Company E]].<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
====Senate Hostage Crisis====
[[File:AurraSing-TCW.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] was a skilled sniper.]]
During the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], when the members of [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] posse arrived at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]], Cad Bane was confronted by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]]. [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] demonstrated her skills as a sniper by single handedly eliminating almost the entire commando squad from an adjacent high-rise building.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

====Battle droid assassin====
The [[Battle droid assassin]] was a variation of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the Clone Wars. Programming for incredible accuracy, proved lethal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] clone troopers. The droids were equipped with a [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|BAW]] [[E-5s sniper rifle/Legends|E-5s sniper rifle]] as well as a standard [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], and an [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturret]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref>

During the first half of the Clone Wars, battle droid assassins wore either no markings, like the standard infantry droids, or red markings, like the security droids. Assassin droid were used more frequently during the second half of the war, during which they were painted with camouflage patterns.These sniper units were used mostly for eliminating special targets such as enemy commanders or other highly dangerous foes. Droid assassins were deployed at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in defense of the most important units waiting to be loaded onto transports, the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]] against [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]], and at the defense of the Separatist stronghold on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

====Sniper droideka====
The CIS also used a variation of [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]], known as [[Sniper droideka/Legends|sniper droideka]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. These droids were equipped with a cannon mounted on their heads. Two such droids was used during the [[Battle of Kiros]].<ref name="The Clone Wars 1">[[The Clone Wars 1|''The Clone Wars'' 1]]</ref>

====Neimoidian Sniper====
[[File:Sniperdroid.jpg|thumb|right|175px|A [[Battle droid assassin]].]]

This variant trooper of the [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion]] focused upon using Sniper rifles to target enemies from afar. These CIS troopers wore the same armor as that of the Neimoidian Warriors, but the uniform was colored a bottle-green. The units were assigned near Neimoidian leaders for protection, such as [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] on his fatal occupation on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The Neimoidian Snipers were all killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on Mustafar.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith video game">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref>

====Clone snipers====
During the Clone Wars, [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], a member of Delta Squad, was a notable sharpshooter who used the sniper attachment of the [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System]] for missions.

[[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|Clone snipers]], also known as Clone sharpshooters, were a specialized variant of [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] that served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. They carried specialized [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x sniper rifles]], [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], autoturrets, thermal detonators, and [[R-1 recon droid]]s while in the field. Clone sharpshooters wore camouflage suits at the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]].

Their main mission on the battle field was to eliminate the Separatist [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] from a distance, but they could also use their recon droids to carry out short-range reconnaissance. Clone snipers were chosen from only the most accurate and alert Clone troops, and may have received specialized training from [[clone assassin]]s. The Clone sharpshooters later reformed into the scout troopers.

===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:Lining_Up_the_Shot_AoRCR.png|thumb|left|180px|Rebel sharpshooter lining up his shot]]

====Rebel Marksmen====
[[Rebel Marksman/Legends|Rebel marksmen]] were chosen from only the most accurate of soldiers that joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and were used in long-range engagements, typically to knock out enemy commanders and create confusion among the troops. Many marksman were used in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] to slow the enemy advance. It was said that a good rebel sniper could make an advancing group of stormtroopers into two fleeing ones.

The primary weapon used was a sniper rifle. Rebel marksmen were also equipped with blaster pistols for close-quarters fighting, a thermal detonator and either an auto turret or recon droid. Auto turrets were used to create a fortified position.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront" />

====Imperial military====
The [[Imperial Military/Legends|imperial military]] employed several different types sharpshooter. A shooter would typically be equipped with a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] like the [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20A blaster rifle]] or the [[E-11s sniper rifle/Legends|E-11s sniper rifle]] and a personal sidearm like the [[Scout trooper blaster pistol/Legends|Scout pistol]].

'''Stormtrooper Corps'''{{Main|Stormsniper}}
The imperial [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|stormtrooper corps]] used stormtrooper snipers on various worlds and even super star destroyer like the ''[[Executor/Legends|Executor]]. ''Some of them were equipped with [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifle]] like the [[RT-97C heavy blaster rifle/Legends|RT-97C heavy blaster rifle]]. While [[Taxtro Grave|others]] was armed the long barrered [[T-28 repeating sniper rifle]].

They carried largely standard [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] and a [[white]] or [[blue]] [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="Assault Team">''[[Star Wars: Assault Team]]''</ref>

'''Scout Trooper'''{{Main|Scout trooper/Legends}}
Scout troopers was another type of highly accurate specialist in the stormtrooper corps. These troops were also trained as survivalists. And to ride [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]]. They carried imperial [[Scout trooper armor/Legends|scout armor]], which was lighter and more practical for their field of operations.<ref name="Complete Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Five scout troopers would make up a [[Scout lance|Scout (lance) squad]].

'''Special forces and sharpshooter squad'''[[File:Scout_trooper_GH_by_Urbach.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Scout troopers on a mission]]
{{Main|Imperial Army Special Missions trooper}}
The Imperial Army Special Missions trooper was not a sharpshooter specialist ''per se. ''But instead highly trained [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]]. These troops could be organized into platoon, [[Company/Legends|company]] and [[Special missions battalion|battalion]] level units. With the [[special missions platoon]] having two [[sharpshooter squad]]s of special missions trooper equipped with [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]] and unofficially a [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster rifle]] each.<ref name="ISB2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The sniper is an advanced class for the [[Imperial Agent]] class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMO video game. This advanced class specializes in [[Blaster rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]], the use of cover to execute ambushes, the ability to call down orbital strikes, and dealing high amounts of damage in battle. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] counterpart for this archetype is the [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]].<ref name="FanFriday" />
